title: Hibike! Euphonium: Suisougaku-bu no Nichijou
justification: AniList: 7 shorts of 2 min, 2015-06-17 to 2015-12-16 "Suisougaku-bu no Nichijou". The detail named S2 only as a date match; the titles are the match: AniDB 10889 S2-S8 are "The Everyday Life of Band Part 1-7" (J 吹奏楽部の日常 その1-7) on 2015-06-17 ... 2015-12-16, and AniList's title is exactly 吹奏楽部の日常. S1 "Ready, Set, Monaka" (2015-12-16, a 24-min special) is another entry and is excluded, so the specials are S2-S8, consecutive. The parent's rows send S1 to 0x8 and S2-S8 to 0x1-0x7; TVDB 289884 0x1-0x7 "The Everyday Life of Band Part 1-7" (2015-06-16 ... 2015-12-16, one day early on part 1) and 0x8 "Ready, Set, Monaka" confirm it. Nothing else claims 0x1-0x7 (11747 0x9, 11746 0x10-0x16, 12962 0x17, 13491 0x18, 13207 0x19, 17441 0x20).
